title: YAP: Yield Modeling and Simulation for Advanced Packaging
problem: Cu-Cu hybrid bonding for chiplet integration suffers from yield loss due to overlay errors, particle defects, Cu recess variations, wafer roughness, and Cu density; no efficient analytical model for rapid design optimization.
motivation: 3D chiplet integration is essential for extending Moore's Law; accurate yield prediction enables co-optimization of bonding pitch, assembly design rules, and process controls.
method: YAP: analytical yield model for W2W and D2W Cu-Cu hybrid bonding accounting for five key failure mechanisms; near-analytical model compared against Monte Carlo simulation; 10,000x faster runtime.
key_novelty: First comprehensive yield model for hybrid bonding enabling rapid design-space exploration.
contributions: YAP yield model for W2W and D2W hybrid bonding
Accounts for overlay, particle defects, Cu recess, surface roughness, Cu density
Near-analytical model with 10,000x faster runtime than simulation
Enables bonding pitch optimization and process control trade-offs
limitations: Specific technology nodes and bonding pitch ranges not detailed; sensitivity to process corner variations not discussed.
primary_theme: Analytical yield model for Cu-Cu hybrid bonding in chiplet integration
